import json
with open("./trajectories/51-12__cand_0003__t0.json", 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)
    
trace = data['rollout']['trace']
for i, turn in enumerate(trace):
    if turn['role'] == 'assistant':
        print(f"--- Turn {i} ---")
        print(turn['content'][:1000])
    elif turn['role'] == 'user':
        print(f"--- Turn {i} User ---")
        print(turn['content'][:500])
